tools.name: search-events
tools.description: Search upcoming published events on Pandy Tickets in Guatemala, soonest first, 20 per page. Each result has its public URL, dates, venue, how people get in (free, transfer or card) and the lowest price.

tools.name: get-event
tools.description: One published event: description, ticket types with prices and whether each is sold out, what the registration form asks, and how people get in (entry.url and Spanish entry.instructions to relay).

tools.name: get-checkout-link
tools.description: The link a person opens to buy tickets or register, with Spanish instructions to relay. For paid events (card or bank transfer), checkout opens with the ticket type and quantity already chosen. For free registration, it is the event page. tools.name: draft-event
tools.description: Prepare a person's own event on Pandy Tickets from what they told you (name, date, place, ticket categories with price and quantity). findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search-events, get-event, get-checkout-link, draft-event · Private data: draft-event · Public sink: draft-event.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search-events, get-event, get-checkout-link, draft-event · Private data: draft-event · Public sink: draft-event

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
